blocks.text: Genetics aur genomics ka shoba pecheeda genetic data ke analysis ke liye biostatistics par bohat bharosa karta hai. Is mein genes aur bimariyon ka taalluq dhoondna, virasat ke patterns (inheritance patterns) samajhna aur genetic farq (variations) dekhna shamil hai. Personalized medicine mein, jahan ilaaj har shakhs ke genetic profile ke mutabiq banaya jata hai, biostatistical tareeqe zaroori hain, taa ke asar barhe aur nuqsan wale asraat (adverse effects) kam hon.
